description: Combined form of the Tail write tools: preview_tail_post, publish_tail_post, share_graded_ticket_to_tail, tail_react, set_show_my_record, set_synced_record_consent and add_doctor_parlay_to_slip (same fields, same answers): version bsd-agent-tail-v1 and one action. Publish only after showing the exact preview and getting the customer's yes; publishing never places a wager.

active.description: react only: true adds fire, false removes it.

consent.description: synced_record_consent only: true lets your connected sportsbook settle your posted picks on your public record (default false).

draft.description: The exact app post draft: either a saved Grade report or a saved Doctor exchange.

messageId.description: Saved Doctor reply in that thread.

reportId.description: Owned saved Grade job ID for a ticket post.

threadId.description: Owned Doctor thread for an exchange post.

key.description: doctor_parlay_slip only: the parlay key from get_doctor_parlays, or the parlay.key on a Doctor reply (get_doctor_job / get_doctor_conversation).

reportId.description: share_report only: the saved Grade report to share.

show.description: record_settings only: true shows your record to others (default), false hides it from everyone but you.

name: tail_post
title: Preview or publish to Tail
